messages:
emma: Heads-up: community refapp launch next Tue. Need a short launch post, 2 social cards, a 30m workshop, and inbound lead routing. Who takes what?
diego: I’ll draft the launch post + social snippets. Aim ~150 words, 3 callouts (quickstart, bench highlight, contrib guide).
sarah: I can do the workshop sign-up page + registration form. Suggest 30m session with 15m hands-on.
noah: Bench lead here. Plan: two tiny microbenches: cache hit p95 and cost-per-1k tokens with batching on. I’ll keep numbers as percent improvements.
diego: For hero metric thinking: "~4x lower p95 with prefix cache on common prompts" 12; Noah confirm?
noah: I can validate. Will run quick A/B and post p50/p95 and a % delta.
emma: Sarah, can you include form fields: name, email, org, role, use-case (prod/dev/research), "want workshop lab" checkbox, and tag leads with "refapp-community-2026"? SFDC campaign MKG-REF-2026-05.
sarah: Yep. Also add a hidden utm param for source=community-thread.
diego: Draft snippet for reproducible bench to include in post (<=4 lines):
```
# cache vs no-cache (wrk)
wrk -t2 -c100 -d20s --latency https://demo.redwood.ai/refapp/v1/generate
# simple quant bench
python bench/run.py --model refapp_v1 --seq 256
```
design-bot: Uploaded social card drafts: /assets/refapp-card-1.png and -2.png. Please review.
build-bot: Demo cluster provisioned: demo-refapp-2026 (3xA10G), URL https://demo.redwood.ai/refapp/v1, expires 72h after launch dry-run. Read-only token issued.
emma: Good. Routing: high-engage (attended + demo-click) -> AE queue B, others -> nurture drip 14-day. Noah, include lead scoring field based on "want workshop" + clicks.
noah: Will add a score rule: workshop=yes + demo_clicks>1 -> priority.
diego: I’ll PR the post + social copy by EOD tomorrow. Sarah will publish form + page.
emma: Timeline: post live -> 1h social push -> community email -> 24h reminder for workshop. Quick check-in Mon 09:00 PT. Any blockers?
sarah: Need design signoff for hero card. Pinged @design.
diego: No blockers from copy side.
noah: Running bench tonight and will attach a small CSV with p50/p95/cost rows.
emma: Thanks team :rocket: Let’s keep everything reproducible and short. "
